detail: Forward filter: 5 known-answer tests (hand calculation; uninformative data; agreement with hmmlearn on likelihood and last-day probabilities with earlier days differing; extreme observation; truncation). Look-ahead harness: passes a trailing mean; fails a centred mean, a one-day back-shift and full-sample standardisation, as it must. Real pipeline: features causal at 4 cuts; hmmlearn smoothed probabilities caught as leaking (negative control); plain-HMM walk-forward signals unchanged at 5 cuts (day before a refit, refit day, day after, mid-block, sixth block). Signals were compared for equality only; no performance was computed.

Timing run of state selection on 2010-01-19 to 2014-12-31: held-out log-likelihood on the last 20% of the window was -1298.9 (2 states), -1039.7 (3) and -979.0 (4); 4 states chosen, the top of the frozen grid. Settings unchanged.

item: Semi-Markov fitting constants fixed before any out-of-sample run
detail: Expectation-maximisation: at most 30 iterations; stop when the training log-likelihood improves by less than 0.01; variance floor 0.001 on scaled features; negative binomial r bounded to 0.05-200 and p to 0.0001-0.9999; each of the five starts is the plain HMM fitted with that seed, rewritten with geometric durations. These were not in the frozen settings table because the model had not been specified at that level; they are fixed here and will not be changed after the out-of-sample run.

Geometric durations reproduce the plain forward filter to 1e-10; hazard of a geometric law is constant and the cap forces an exit; filter unchanged by truncation; on simulated data with mean regime lengths 41 and 21 days the fit recovers 39.2 and 20.7, with r well above 1 and a higher likelihood than the plain HMM it started from; likelihood never decreases across iterations; filtered regime classification on held-out simulated data at least as accurate as the plain HMM. Walk-forward look-ahead test passed at 3 cuts over the first two blocks. Signals were compared for equality only; no performance was computed.

item: First training-window semi-Markov fit (training data only)
detail: State selection on 2010-01-19 to 2014-12-31: held-out log-likelihood -1199.8 (2 states), -1039.8 (3), -978.1 (4); 4 states chosen. Plain HMM on the same window: -1298.9, -1039.7, -979.0. Training log-likelihood rose from -4798.0 (plain HMM start) to -4370.4. No expected exits at the 252-day cap; largest probability of a duration reaching the cap under the fitted law 2.4%.
